Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 17-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Punjabi University Lecturer (Sociology) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Punjabi University Lecturer (Sociology) recruitment is 17 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Lecturer (Sociology) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Lecturer (Sociology) position announced by Punjabi University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for this recruitment must be submitted via Email.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for the Lecturer (Sociology) post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Lecturer (Sociology) post is scheduled to be held on 18 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a Contractual job position at Punjabi University.

faq.question: Q7. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Punjabi University.

faq.question: Q8. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located in Ghudda, Punjab.

faq.question: Q9. What are the important dates for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The important dates include the Notification Date (10 September 2026), Last Date to Apply (17 September 2026), and Walk-in Interview Date (18 September 2026).

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Lecturer (Sociology) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Lecturer (Sociology) post will be based on an Interview.
